caption:
The Gabby & Doozie Sister Fun Pack (Gabby, Pandy Paws, Cakey Cat, Doozie, Puggie Paws, Creampup) and the Fairylandia Fairy-riffic Friends 6-pack are both about $20 at Walmart in our November 27 check. The Doozie pack was out of stock at Walmart on November 23, and Amazon search results showed it as currently unavailable on November 23 and 24. Walmart's listings say both packs go with the Meow-mazing Dollhouse. The Puggie Paws plush (about $15) is a pre-order, due in December, and our two sources disagree on the day; the LEGO set 11227 (about $20) is listed for January 1, 2027.

Every Doozie's Doghouse toy, store by store, with the dates we checked: https://everylittleroom.com/guides/doozies-doghouse-toys?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=long

Independent parents' site, not affiliated with the show or its makers. Prices are typical US store prices from our dated checks, never Amazon's. Synthetic voice. As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases.
title: Doozie's pack or the Gabby 6-pack for Christmas? About $20 each, one hard to find
